description: Defines internal functions and constants for seed material generation in the Abseil random library, including entropy collection, seed mixing, and salt retrieval.

methods.name: SeedBitsToBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of 32-bit blocks needed to contain a given number of bits.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromOSEntropy
methods.description: Fills a span of uint32_t with entropy from the operating system source.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromURBG
methods.description: Fills a span of uint32_t with values generated from a URBG.

methods.name: MixIntoSeedMaterial
methods.description: Mixes a sequence of values into seed material to enhance entropy.

methods.name: GetSaltMaterial
methods.description: Retrieves a salt value used in seed generation, may return empty if unavailable.
